newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks mixed amid cross deals.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks mixed amid cross deals.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed on Monday in sessions dominated by pocket-to-pocket cross deals in little-traded shares.
Bogota's IBB index edged up 0.05 percent in Bogota to 1,068.29 amid a 5.6 billion peso volume while Medellin's IBOMED index fell 0.3 percent to 16,571.15 amid a 879 million peso trade.

The bulk of the volume in Bogota was made up by a 3.65 billion peso cross trade in financial corporation Corporacion Financiera Colombiana, owned by banking magnate Luis Carlos Sarmiento, and in communications company Colomsat.
